scope: All vendor-adjusted absolute daily returns above 50 percent, plus every adjustment-change event with a residual adjusted return above 20 percent.

events.evidence: Target reported third-quarter results and reduced full-year EPS guidance on the same date.
Carvana filed a same-day Form 8-K and improved its second-quarter outlook.

limitations: This review classifies the release-threshold events in the canonical US300 file; it does not prove that Yahoo Finance contains every corporate action.
